# elif

Continue an indented conditional branch using the DCode spelling.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.elif` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | Conditional |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `elif <condition>:` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `elif condition:<br>    -- body<br>` |

## Transformation

## Example

```lua
elif condition:
    -- body
```
